case_decision: Enel: 2023 Australia/Hellas ownership restructuring and eligible-pool replacement
declared_rationale: Partnership-led value creation and continued renewable development; the annual report retrospectively identifies these disposals with stewardship in non-core countries.
documented_financing_link: Direct, bounded allocation link: the 2023 report attributes EUR 156.86m of the 2019 issue’s replacement to deconsolidation. Sale receipts are not traced to replacement-project spending.
ownership_or_physical_outcome_boundary: 50% subsidiary interests sold; joint control retained. Cohuna/Kafireas assignments replaced by Alta Farms II/Seven Cowboy. Pool exit does not establish plant retirement or complete economic exit.
timing_note: Australian agreement 13 July/closing 29 September 2023; Hellas agreement 26 July/closing 29 December 2023. Reallocation known at 2023 vintage only.

case_decision: Iberdrola: Mexico generation-portfolio sale, announced 2023 and completed 26 February 2024
declared_rationale: Capital recycling toward renewables and opportunities in the United States/Europe, stronger financial ratios, and continuing service to Mexican private customers.
documented_financing_link: Corporate recycling rationale is explicit; neither sale receipts nor the transaction are linked to the selected 2019 hybrid in the inspected records.
ownership_or_physical_outcome_boundary: Ownership exit, with buyer-trust PPAs and temporary management services. Annual reporting specifies planned purchases from four sold plants. The 8,539 MW transaction perimeter and 8,494 MW gas-capacity bridge remain distinct.
timing_note: MoU 4 April 2023; strategy presentation 5 April; binding agreement 12 June; closing 26 February 2024. Contract links do not establish retained equity or realized post-sale generation.

case_decision: SSE: Keadby 2 investment/commissioning and Triton acquisition, preceding the matched 2023–2024 interval
declared_rationale: Efficient gas generation and flexible support for renewables; Keadby 2’s expected commercial returns and allocated construction risk; Triton’s security-of-supply role and prospective hydrogen/CCS options.
documented_financing_link: Corporate strategic complementarity is explicit; a GB5 funding link to either fossil event is not documented. GB5 assignments concern three wind projects.
ownership_or_physical_outcome_boundary: Keadby 2 commissioned on 15 March 2023; existing Triton assets acquired on 1 September 2022. Hydrogen/CCS remained prospective. The old Tarbert oil station closed within the matched interval under a reported licence constraint.
